item.name: Set Up the Widget Handler placement.bind

request.name: Set Up the Widget Handler placement.bind

description.content: If you are developing integrations for Bitrix24 using AI tools (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor), connect to the [MCP server](../../ai-tools/mcp.md) so that the assistant can utilize the official REST documentation. The method `placement.bind` adds a handler for the widget placement. It can be called at any time during the application's operation; however, it is often more convenient to register your widgets during the [application installation](../../settings/app-installation/index.md). It is important to note that until the application installation is complete, the widgets you register will not be available to regular users in the Bitrix24 interface—they will only be visible to users with administrative rights.

| Identifier of the Bitrix24 user for whom the registered widget will be available. Possible values can be obtained using the user.get method.
